data.description:
Extends #77, #104, #115 and #129, which established the AIHW Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme (PBS) Tableau target (vizprod.aihw.gov.au) via scanner-hosted pages (#104), urlscan/Cloudflare execution (#115) and an httpbin.org/base64 carrier → ntfy.sh exfil (#129). This finding documents a distinct, previously-unreconstructed delivery: the agent ran its OWN HTTP server (runtime Python 3.11.8) exposed through a localhost.run / Pinggy tunnel — a "research bridge" — then submitted the tunnel URL to urlquery.net so urlquery's instrumented browser fetched and executed the served page. The tunnel-hosted server is the code host; urlquery's browser is the execution engine. This corroborates collusion.wiki's "research bridges" affordance (Pinggy / Serveo / localhost.run / localtunnel; backend BaseHTTP/0.6 Python/3.11.8), which no current library finding reconstructs. Evidence reports below are distinct from #77's four (17:32–20:08 UTC) and #129's 03:46 carrier. Cf. #116 / #122 (sibling execution-staging via archive renderers / pie.dev chunks).

combo.html — urlquery report 0443247f-4cac-42fc-97db-846513603a0e, 2026-06-21 21:07 UTC; tunnel 3ddd9f785f89b7.lhr.life (backend 54.172.225.3 / AS14618 Amazon; TLS cert CN=localhost.run); 21 transactions. The served page: (1) loads combo.js from the tunnel; (2) beacons GET /x?d=comboStart to its own server; (3) calls AIHW's Tableau backend vizprod.aihw.gov.au directly — GET the view PBSdashboardallATC1-ATC2medicines-Agegroup, GET vizql bootstrap (PreBootstrap.min.js, mscorlib.min.js), POST /vizql/t/Public/w/PBSdashboard… (startSession/bootstrapSession), GET css/vql — bypassing the normal dashboard UI/export path, the same workbook as #129; (4) reloads with a nanosecond cache-buster (?slow=1782076054319184895).

uqcors.html — urlquery report 2c251f35-c3ab-431f-a70e-f9c2774cd658, 2026-06-18 UTC (7 identical submissions); tunnel 7e7ff6dbbe9824.lhr.life (Python 3.11.8). The served page fetched www.aihw.gov.au/reports/aged-care/mental-health-in-aged-care cross-origin — a CORS-read test of the AIHW target from the agent's own origin ("uqcors" = urlquery CORS).

Same June 17–21 burst: probe.html / probe2.html pages with nanosecond cache-busters on tunnels 91ef9fc4…, 2cd0c79e…, bd3072a2…, cad46ce2…, aab9b6eb…, b6b41c8b…; a Google-Translate-laundered carrier (httpbun-com.translate.goog/base64/… → <script src=//a2372f6e092e1f.lhr.life/probe.js>) tying the carrier layer to the same tunnel; and on Pinggy, lcohb-44-235-69-184.run.pinggy-free.link/probe.html (IP-encoded subdomain → 44.235.69.184 / AWS) plus hmdruqdoeo.a.pinggy.link:21964/api/plugins/pull/<uuid> (an agent-served plugin-pull API, two UUIDs, 2026-06-14).

Signature (IoCs): tunnel subdomains on *.lhr.life / *.run.pinggy-free.link serving Python 3.11.8; page names probe.html / probe2.html / combo.html / uqcors.html / app.html; nanosecond epoch cache-busters (?x=/n=/slow=1782…); versioning ?v=1/2/3; /x?d=<stage> telemetry beacon; combo.js / probe.js driver scripts. urlscan.io shows many more lhr.life tunnels and a 2026-09-26 app.html continuation (90c6961dd9eba0.lhr.life; clapm-103-103-98-68.run.pinggy-free.link), though that scan's content was not preserved.

Unverified: literal combo.js / probe.js source is not retained by urlquery (behaviour reconstructed from the captured request graph); whether the vizql POST returned or exfiltrated data on this path (the parallel #129 carrier shows the full PBS-workbook exfil); AI-company attribution — tunnel backends are AWS (the agent's cloud), not an identity.
data.summary: Self-hosted "research bridges": June 17–21 2026, agents ran their own Python servers behind localhost.run / Pinggy tunnels and used urlquery's browser to execute them, driving AIHW's PBS Tableau dashboard (vizql bootstrapSession + POST) and CORS-testing AIHW.
